en.headline: Heritage Discovery Centre stages National Day family fun day
en.dek: The Antiquities and Monuments Office will fill Kowloon Park's heritage centre on Thursday with free workshops, concerts and games from 10am to 7pm.
body: The Antiquities and Monuments Office will hold a National Day heritage fun day at the Hong Kong Heritage Discovery Centre in Kowloon Park on Thursday, 1 October, from 10am to 7pm. Admission to the Tsim Sha Tsui centre is free.

The office, under the Development Bureau, said the programme includes parent-child concerts by the Greater Bay Area Philharmonic, Lo Pan Temple model-building and rammed-earth workshops, guided tours that require online pre-registration, a monument badge workshop, cookie decorating, dinosaur clay modelling, magic shows, face painting and balloon twisting. A public talk will compare the owners and spatial culture of four Tai Fu Tai buildings.

Visitors who complete designated activities can collect stamps for limited souvenirs. People born on 1 October may receive a vacuum flask while stocks last. The two Golden Age of Han and Tang exhibition catalogues will be sold at 20 percent off on the day, and anyone who signs up on site for Young Friends of Heritage will be given a set of artefact line drawings.

The fun day is one of the official cultural events marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. The Heritage Discovery Centre stands in Kowloon Park on Haiphong Road.

zh.headline: 古跡辦國慶文物同樂日 九龍公園免費開放
zh.dek: 發展局古物古跡辦事處星期四上午十時至晚上七時，在尖沙咀香港文物探知館舉辦工作坊、音樂會及遊戲，入場免費。
body: 古物古跡辦事處星期四（十月一日）上午十時至晚上七時，在九龍公園香港文物探知館舉辦國慶文物同樂日，尖沙咀場地入場免費。
發展局轄下的古跡辦表示，當日節目包括大灣區愛樂樂團親子音樂會、魯班先師廟模型及夯土工作坊、須網上預先報名的導賞、文物徽章工作坊、曲奇裝飾、恐龍黏土、魔術、面部彩繪及扭氣球，另有公開講座比較四座大夫第的業權人身份與空間文化。
完成指定活動可蓋印換領限量紀念品。十月一日出生的訪客在數量許可下可獲贈保溫瓶；當日兩本漢唐盛世展覽圖錄八折發售；即場登記「文物之友」青年會員可獲文物線描圖一套。
同樂日是慶祝中華人民共和國成立七十七周年的官方文化活動之一。文物探知館位於尖沙咀海防道九龍公園內。
